name: Beta Trial Information | Sentrya Whole Health
description: Discover how Sentrya empowers people with chronic conditions with intuitive tools to track migraines, sleep, glucose, pain, and medications and communicate effectively with healthcare providers.

about.name: Sentrya Whole Health
about.description: A whole health tracking app for migraines, sleep, glucose, pain, and medication. Log symptoms, spot patterns, and share data with healthcare providers.

offers.description: Beta testers receive lifetime full access

featureList: Pain and migraine tracking with symptom, trigger, and relief logging
Sleep tracking with quality, duration, and interruption monitoring
Glucose history via Dexcom and HealthKit/Health Connect integration
Medication management with dosage, timing, and effectiveness tracking
Provider reports with printable summaries for appointments
Dim mode for low-light use during migraine attacks
Voice control with in-browser transcription for hands-free logging
Weather widget with barometric pressure for migraine trigger identification
Correlation engine showing patterns across health metrics
